profile.name: Aditya Gupta
profile.title: Electrical Engineering @ IIT Kharagpur | Embedded Systems & Controls | Data Analytics
profile.tagline: Mathematics enthusiast, competitive programmer, and embedded robotics engineer passionate about control theory, autonomous vehicles, and mathematical modeling.
profile.bio: Electrical Engineering undergraduate at the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (IIT KGP). Passionate about the intersection of rigorous mathematical analysis, embedded systems & control algorithms, and data-driven intelligence. Actively engineering autonomous navigation and aerial systems at Aerial Robotics Kharagpur (ARK) and Students' Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (SAVP/NSCOT).

projects.title: Mexican Real Estate Market Analysis: Location vs. Home Size
projects.subtitle: Comprehensive econometric & statistical data analysis on complex property pricing
projects.description: Conducted in-depth data manipulation and multivariate cleaning using Pandas DataFrame at WorldQuant University. Engineered correlation pipelines to assess how geographic location and home size drive price variances. Generated granular statistical visualizations including distribution histograms, heatmaps, and spatial scatter plots.
projects.metrics: Cleaned 10k+ property records | High correlation predictive model

projects.title: Token Trend - AI Cryptocurrency Forecasting Engine
projects.subtitle: Real-time OHLCV feature extraction and price movement prediction for 20+ digital assets
projects.description: Developed Token-Trend, a machine learning forecasting engine predicting directional price fluctuations for over 20 cryptocurrencies using Logistic Regression. Built an asynchronous pipeline processing live OHLCV candlestick data feeds for sub-minute market trend inference.
projects.metrics: Real-time streaming pipeline | 20+ Crypto Assets Analyzed

projects.title: StratQuest: Indian Railways Delay Prediction & Network Optimization
projects.subtitle: High-precision 92.1% delay forecasting and bottleneck mitigation model (SHARE, IIT KGP)
projects.description: Engineered a Python-based delay prediction model achieving 92.1% accuracy by isolating track maintenance as the predominant cascading delay factor. Designed a multi-tiered rail optimization framework with automated track bifurcation and conducted a rigorous cost-benefit guesstimate for a Sand Spray adhesion system (~₹5 Lakhs/train).
